journey.name: Profile and settings — identity, copy pubky, sign out
journey.description: Own profile, the settings screen (identity info, copy pubky) and sign-out back to onboarding. Run LAST — it ends the session. Requires a signed-in session.

actions.action: Launch the Loopky app and verify the Home screen is shown
Tap the element with resource-id "tab_profile" in the bottom tab bar
Verify the profile screen shows the user's identity (name or truncated pubky)

Force-stop and relaunch the app, then tap "tab_profile" again and verify the hero (avatar, name, pubky chip) and the Decks/Cards counts are on screen immediately, with no full-screen "Loading your profile" spinner covering them — the persisted session and the deck snapshot are painted first and refreshed underneath

On that first paint verify the "Due" stat reads an em dash rather than "0", and that it becomes a real number once the load finishes; review state is not cached across launches, so a zero there would be a guess

If the account has no display name (the hero falls back to the pubky), verify the "What should we call you?" card is shown under the hero with "Add name" (resource-id: profile_name_nudge_action) and "Not now" (resource-id: profile_name_nudge_dismiss); on a named account verify no such card appears
If the card is shown, tap "Add name" and verify the Edit Profile sheet opens with an empty name field, then dismiss it
If the card is shown, tap "Not now" and verify the card disappears; relaunch the app, return to the profile tab and verify it stays gone
Verify a camera badge (resource-id: profile_edit_avatar) sits on the bottom-right of the hero avatar, drawn as a whole circle rather than clipped by the avatar's edge

Tap it and verify a "Change your photo" dialog appears saying photos are set on pubky.app with the same key, offering "Open pubky.app" (resource-id: profile_avatar_open_pubky_app) and "Not now"; tap "Not now" to close it

If the account has a display name but no profile photo, verify the "How about a photo?" card is shown under the hero with "Open pubky.app" (resource-id: profile_avatar_nudge_action) and "Not now" (resource-id: profile_avatar_nudge_dismiss); on an account with a photo verify no such card appears
Verify the photo card and the name card are never shown together: on a nameless account only the "What should we call you?" card appears, and the photo card returns once a name is published
If the photo card is shown, tap "Open pubky.app" and verify the browser opens this environment's pubky.app profile page, then return to Loopky
If the photo card is shown, tap "Not now" and verify the card disappears while the camera badge stays; relaunch the app, return to the profile tab and verify the card stays gone
Tap the element with resource-id "profile_settings"
Verify the Settings screen is shown with an Identity section (truncated pubky, homeserver) and a "Sign out" row (resource-id: settings_signout)
Tap the element with resource-id "settings_copy_pubky" and verify no crash occurs
Tap the element with resource-id "settings_signout"
Verify a confirmation dialog appears
Confirm sign out
Verify the app returns to the onboarding screen with the "Sign in with Pubky Ring" button (resource-id: onboarding_signin)
